sources.title: dys-asr/parakeet-ctc-0.6b-sapc2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The SAPC1 model got its statistics from a single GPU holding all 32 examples. Splitting across two GPUs would ordinarily drop that to 16 and change the model, so SyncBatchNorm is applied to all 24 layers, which all-reduces the statistics and restores them to the same 32 examples.

sources.title: GitHub - achetronic/parakeet: OpenAI Whisper-compatible ASR server ...
sources.snippet: A high-performance automatic speech recognition (ASR) server written in Go. It uses NVIDIA's Parakeet TDT 0.6B model through ONNX Runtime to provide speech-to-text transcription via an OpenAI Whisper-compatible API.
